title: Air conditioning cooling strength and vent usability
summary: Feedback on the G70 air conditioning centers on weak cooling or airflow and hard-to-use vent or climate controls, while many sampled mentions are requests or observations with unclear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mainly note desired climate-related comfort features such as using cool air with other seat functions or wanting air-conditioned seats, with limited evidence of satisfaction with core A/C performance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor overall air conditioning performance, weak airflow, trouble reaching or maintaining the desired temperature, and poor vent design.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention weak cooling, low airflow, slower cabin cooling, rear vents performing worse than front, intermittent shutoff, off-ignition operation limits, and requests for more physical climate controls, but the sample does not clearly separate complaints from feature observations in many cases.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence about overall sentiment patterns.
The positive sample is very small and does not clearly show strong approval of A/C performance itself.
Some examples appear to be feature requests, comparisons to other vehicles, or operational observations rather than clear evaluations of a defect or benefit.
The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative estimates of all G70 feedback on this topic.
